level.title: Autonomy level
level.hint: The level decides which tools the agent may use on its own. Below, single tools can be restricted further, never widened.

explain.1: Reads pages, tickets and the conversation, and answers. Changes nothing.
explain.2: Reads like level 1, proposes changes to pages, comments and creates tickets. A person accepts proposals.
explain.3: Like level 2, writes pages directly (only in spaces that allow it), hands tickets on and writes messages in conversations it is a member of.

tools.title: Tools
tools.hint: Each tool is allowed from a level up. Here it can only be tightened: only after a person approves, or blocked altogether.

names.propose_page_change: Propose a change to a page
names.set_ticket_status: Set a ticket's status (up to “In review”)
names.link_ticket_page: Link a ticket to a page

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.hint: The agent works here with the role shown. Members are added in a space's settings.
spaces.empty: In no space yet. It still reads open spaces.

skills.title: Skills
skills.hint: In a run the agent knows each skill's name and description and loads the text when it needs it.
skills.assignHint: Offered are the active skills you can see.

unavailable.archived: Not available: the skill is archived.
unavailable.unreachable: Not available: the agent does not read this skill's space.

personal.title: My agents
personal.description: Your own agents: they work only in your personal space, at most at level 2, with your model and on your account.
personal.createHint: It uses your model, you are responsible, and it is a member of your personal space.
personal.instructionsHint: What it should do and how it answers; its personality belongs here too.
personal.disabled: Personal agents are switched off in this organisation (or you do not use AI). You cannot make new ones, and existing ones do not answer.
personal.empty: You have no agents of your own yet.
personal.levelCap: Personal agents work at most at level 2.

agent.tool_unknown: This tool does not exist (any more). Please reload.
agent.skill_not_assignable: At least one skill cannot be given to this agent (unknown, or outside its spaces).
agent.skill_names_clash: Two of the skills have the same name; an agent can have only one of them.
agent.personal_disabled: Personal agents are switched off in this organisation.
agent.personal_limit: You already have as many agents of your own as allowed. Delete one to make a new one.
agent.personal_space_only: A personal agent works only in its person's personal space.
agent.connection_unavailable: The agent's AI connection is off or no longer offers the model. Save the agent again so it takes the current assignment.
